known_risks: NVIDIA Isaac Sim 6.x documentation no longer lists Windows 10 as a supported Windows platform.
The installed NVIDIA driver 560.81 is below the documented Windows recommended driver for Isaac Sim 6.x.
The Isaac Sim pip dependency set installed torch 2.11.0+cpu in this environment; keep LeRobot training/eval in its existing CUDA environment.
next_steps: User must review and accept the NVIDIA Omniverse EULA before the launcher can bootstrap.
Upgrade NVIDIA display driver and preferably run on Windows 11 before relying on GUI/RTX rendering.
After EULA/platform validation, launch the existing preview with scripts\launch_isaac_preview.ps1.
